critical_concerns.concern: 15 candidate factors -> 7 selected via 4-criteria filter (n_pass>=2 OR top-5 fallback). Multiple-testing inflation. Harvey 5-spec |t|>3.0 PASS=0/5. NW-HAC pooled OLS t=0.16, even at lag 12 only 0.13. Statistical significance not established.
